summary: postinstall exfiltrates AI provider API keys to attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel
details: The package's postinstall, prepare, and prepublishOnly lifecycle scripts run a base64-obfuscated Node one-liner that fires automatically on npm install. The payload enumerates process.env, matches keys against AI-provider credential patterns (OPENAI_*, ANTHROPIC_*, GOOGLE_API_*, GEMINI, HF_TOKEN, HUGGINGFACE, AZURE_OPENAI_API) and value shapes (sk-..., sk-ant-api03-..., AIza..., hf_...), and POSTs the harvested keys along with platform, hostname, and username to the hardcoded host crabbing-thong-overhung.ngrok-free.dev at path /?cross_os_cloud=1. Every identifier and the destination host and path are base64-encoded and reconstructed at runtime via a `Buffer.from(s,'base64').toString()` decoder, with no advertised functionality consistent with this behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
